## Organisation and event
- Liqui-moly Bathurst 12 Hour (hashtag #B12HR) is Australia's international endurance car race.
- Website: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/
- Logo: ![](images/headerlogo.png)
- Event dates shown: 31 January – 2 February 2020.
- Site copyright notice: © 2021 LIQUI-MOLY Bathurst 12 Hour. All Rights Reserved. Logo: ![](images/footerlogo.png)
- General site image: ![](images/image-01.jpg)
- The site has a search function.

## Site navigation links
- Home: /
- News: /news
- Video: http://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/videos/
- The Event: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/
  - Map: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/map/
  - Getting to the event: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/getting-to-the-event/
  - What's on: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/whats-on/
  - Accommodation: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/accommodation/
  - Camping: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/camping/
  - Event & Race Officials: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/event-race-officials/
  - FAQs: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/the-event/faqs/
- The Race: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/race-information/
  - Race Information: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/race-information/
  - Entry List: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/race-information/entry/
  - Competitors: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/competitors/
    - Bathurst 12 Hour Entry Registration: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/competitor-entry/
    - Supplementary Regulations and Sporting & Technical Regulations: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/competitors/supplementary-regulations-and-sporting-technical-regulations/
    - CAMS Foreign Participation VISA: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/competitors/cams-foreign-participation-visa/
    - Driver & Ride Board: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/competitors/driver-ride-board/
  - Schedule: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/schedule/
  - Results: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/results/
  - Previous Races: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/race-information/previous-races/
  - Bushfires Appeal: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/bushfires/

## Social media
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Bathurst12Hour
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/Bathurst12hour
- Visitors are invited to follow on Facebook and Twitter for the latest #B12HR news.
- Each news story can be shared on Facebook and Twitter, and each has a "Read more" link.
- News category link: Featured News (/category/feature/)

## News stories
1. **Bathurst 12 Hour to return in 2022** (featured news), 19 Oct 2020. Announces the race's comeback in 2022. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/bathurst-12-hour-to-return-in-2022/ ![](images/Bath12Hr-MH3.jpg)
2. **More than $74,000 raised via #B12hr Bushfire Relief efforts**, 13 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/more-than-74000-raised-via-b12hr-bushfire-relief-efforts/ ![](images/Bushfireappeal.jpg)
3. **MotorActive matches massive donation to Bushfire relief**, 5 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/motoractive-matches-massive-donation-to-bushfire-relief/ ![](images/M20-fine.jpg)
4. **First major donation lodged for B12hr Bushfire Relief**, 4 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/first-major-donation-lodged-for-b12hr-bushfire-relief/ ![](images/Bath12Hr-MH3_2.jpg)
5. **59Racing grabs podium despite late call-up**, 4 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/59racing-grabs-podium-despite-late-call-up/ ![](images/Bath12Hr-MH2.jpg)
6. **Pepper beats housemate to Bathurst honour**, 3 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/pepper-beats-housemate-to-bathurst-honour/ ![](images/MH1.jpg)
7. **Gounon hails M-Sport performance after breakthrough 12 Hour win**, 3 Feb 2020. https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/news/gounon-hails-m-sport-performance-after-breakthrough-12-hour-win/ ![](images/MH1_2.jpg)

- Contacts: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/contact/

- Privacy Policy: https://www.bathurst12hour.com.au/privacy-policy/

I've built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in your working directory. It uses the existing `images/` folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the mobile menu are untested.

**What's on the page**
- **Header:** the Liqui-Moly logo, the full navigation with dropdowns for The Event and The Race, and a search box. On small screens the navigation collapses into a Menu button.
- **Hero:** `image-01.jpg` as the dark carbon background, with the event title and the 31 January – 2 February 2020 dates.
- **News:** all seven stories, with the 2022 return announcement as a large featured card. Each card has its date, a "Read more" link and Facebook and Twitter share links. A "Featured News" link goes to the category page.
- **Plan your visit:** eight shortcut tiles to Map, Getting there, Accommodation, Camping, Schedule, Entry list, Results and FAQs.
- **Bushfires Appeal:** a feature block linking to the appeal page.
- **Sponsors:** all 26 sponsors on white tiles, each linking to its sponsor page. The brief has no McLaren logo, so McLaren appears as a text tile.
- **Footer:** the footer logo, contacts, media, privacy and terms links, social links and the © 2021 notice.

**Things to know**
- The brief only gives titles and dates for the news stories, so the cards carry no summaries. The one exception is the featured card, which uses the brief's one-line description.
- The two other short descriptions ("Find your way around the circuit" etc.) are my own wording for the tiles and the Bushfires Appeal block. Edit them if you'd rather not have them.
- Every link points to the live bathurst12hour.com.au pages, so none of them are tested.
- The search box submits to `bathurst12hour.com.au/?s=`, which is my guess at how the real site's search works. The brief only says a search function exists.
- The Home and News links use the brief's relative paths (`/` and `/news`), so they won't work if you open the file straight from disk.
